content: Web Crypto (crypto.subtle) is stable and globally available in Vercel's Node.js runtime (Node 20/22/24) with no import needed -- globalThis.crypto.subtle. HMAC-SHA256 sign/verify via crypto.subtle.importKey + sign/verify is the standard pattern for signed cookies without a JWT library. Constant-time comparison of the signature (not a short-circuiting === or timing-unsafe string compare) is the standard mitigation for timing attacks on the signature check.
